title: Agent Hooks — interception record
description: Host-side record of one emission (AGENT-HOOKS-0.1 §10.3). Payload-free: identities (when a provider is declared) bind the record to the exact pre/post-composition context; session_id/sequence/decided_by provide ordering and attribution; composition makes the record interpretable without out-of-band host configuration.

verdict.description: The payload-free projection of the combined verdict (§10.3): transform.value dropped, approval members stripped, messages truncated to 256 UTF-8 bytes.

approval.description: Presence only; members are stripped by the projection.

input_identity.description: Identity provider output on the context before dispatch; null iff identity_provider is null.

enforced_identity.description: Identity provider output after composition completes; null iff identity_provider is null.

identity_provider.description: The declared identity provider (§10.1): "jcs-sha256", a host-defined id, or null (identity-unbound).

session_id.description: ctx.session.id — correlates records across a session.

sequence.description: ctx.sequence — total order of records within the session (§12.2.3).

decided_by.description: Registration index of the interceptor whose verdict won aggregation or whose liftable deny was consulted (§7.6); null for a pure-allow combination or a host-synthesized verdict.

composition.description: The composition profile and knobs in effect for this emission (§7.1).

verdicts.description: Payload-free per-interceptor summary. REQUIRED in multi-verdict profiles (sequential/run_all, parallel/*); OPTIONAL in sequential/first_deny.

fold_truncated.description: true iff one or more registered interceptors were never invoked in this emission (short-circuit or approval-stop). Defined only for sequential/first_deny.

resolved_by.description: "approval" iff an approval resolution substituted for a verdict in this emission (§7.6).
